This will fail if called on a `PointMesh`, as it has a single vertex

This doesn't matter for the original code as it also doesn't have an index or normal array, but with this it will crash

Try it out and see

It also won't work for other configurations that aren't triangles (though the original code won't either)

But it all highlights I'd say that the code in general isn't designed for custom cases in mind and requires a broader check and fix

The swap also has to occur for the other types of arrays (UVs, color, etc, otherwise it won't map to the correct vertex.)

(Whoops, hadn't seen your comment below. I agree with it.)
